el-fogon-de-la-llave.title: El Fogón de la Llave
el-fogon-de-la-llave.description: A digital experience created to showcase a countryside destination focused on celebrations, gastronomy, recreation and relaxation in Penco.
el-fogon-de-la-llave.challenge: The challenge was to transform El Fogón de la Llave's identity into a digital experience capable of communicating the essence of the place: nature, gastronomy, celebrations and shared moments.
el-fogon-de-la-llave.solution: We designed a visual, clear and responsive web experience using the venue's identity, spaces and multimedia content to create a warm and memorable digital presence.
el-fogon-de-la-llave.tech: Tailwind CSS, Responsive Design, SEO, Local SEO, WhatsApp Integration, Initial Google Business Profile Setup
el-fogon-de-la-llave.result: A digital presence that combines identity, photography and content to communicate the essence of El Fogón de la Llave while making it easy for visitors to get in touch.

languagelife.title: Language Art Life
languagelife.description: A multilingual digital platform combining language learning, an interactive virtual gallery and educational games for dynamic language practice.
languagelife.challenge: The challenge was to create a digital experience that went beyond a traditional language platform by combining educational content, cultural experiences and interactive elements that encourage exploration and practice.
languagelife.solution: We designed a multilingual web experience combining language-learning content with an interactive virtual gallery for discovering artworks and games designed to make language practice more engaging and participatory.
languagelife.tech: Web Design, Frontend Development, Interactive Experiences, Responsive Design, SEO.
languagelife.result: An educational platform that brings together languages, art and interaction, offering users different ways to explore content and develop their language skills.

vincentalize.title: Vincent Alizé
vincentalize.description: A professional website for the Vincent Alizé music project, designed to showcase his artistic universe, music, performances and audiovisual content.
vincentalize.challenge: The project needed a digital presence capable of bringing Vincent Alizé's artistic identity, music, upcoming performances and audiovisual content together in one cohesive experience while preserving the character of his musical universe.
vincentalize.solution: We designed and developed a visual and immersive web experience that allows visitors to discover the artist, explore albums and songs, view upcoming performances and access music videos and music platforms.
vincentalize.tech: HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript,Responsive Design.
vincentalize.result: A modern artistic digital presence that brings Vincent Alizé's music, performances, videos and contact channels together in a cohesive web experience.

movil-technology.title: Movil Technology
movil-technology.description: A professional website for a business specialized in mobile phone repair and support.
movil-technology.challenge: The goal was to create a clear and professional digital presence for a mobile phone repair business, making it easy for customers to understand the services and quickly find the information they need.
movil-technology.solution: We developed a modern and responsive interface focused on service clarity, trust and straightforward navigation across devices.
movil-technology.tech: Vue.js, Vuetify, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Design,SEO, Local SEO, WhatsApp Integration, Initial Google Business Profile Setup
movil-technology.result: A modern and adaptable digital presence that presents mobile phone repair services in a clear and professional way.

podologa-soley.title: Podóloga Soley
podologa-soley.description: A professional landing page for a podiatry practice, built with Bootstrap 5 and optimized for SEO, AEO and patient acquisition.
podologa-soley.challenge: The goal was to create a professional, fast and accessible digital presence that clearly presents podiatry services, answers common patient questions and facilitates contact while maintaining an efficient and cost-effective infrastructure.
podologa-soley.solution: We developed a responsive landing page using Bootstrap 5, semantic HTML structure, SEO and AEO-optimized content, Schema.org structured data and FAQ markup. The contact form uses a serverless AWS architecture with API Gateway, Lambda and SES to process and deliver messages without requiring a traditional backend server.
podologa-soley.tech: Bootstrap 5, HTML5, JavaScript, SEO, AEO, Schema.org, AWS API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon SES.
podologa-soley.result: A modern and optimized digital presence combining responsive user experience, search visibility, AI answer-engine readiness and a scalable, low-maintenance serverless infrastructure.

nico-castro.title: Nicolás Castro Photography
nico-castro.description: Multilingual artistic photography portfolio designed to showcase high-definition visual work without compromising website performance.
nico-castro.challenge: The photographer needed to display high-definition work without the image weight affecting website performance on mobile devices.
nico-castro.solution: We implemented a dark and minimalist interface that acts as a canvas for the photographs, incorporating advanced compression techniques and lazy loading.
nico-castro.tech: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, WebP Optimization, CloudFront CDN.
nico-castro.result: A highly visual portfolio that loads quickly and presents international photography work in a clean and immersive way.

fidias-place.title: Fidias Place
fidias-place.description: Interactive landing page for a dance academy featuring class schedules, pricing and online registration.
fidias-place.challenge: The academy needed an agile page to attract new students, clearly presenting class schedules and promoting salsa and bachata workshops.
fidias-place.solution: We designed a clear conversion flow with dynamic calls to action and structured schedule tables for easy mobile reading.
fidias-place.result: A significant increase in weekly registrations thanks to a clear, mobile-friendly enrollment flow.

j-avila.title: J-Avila Cleaning & Maintenance
j-avila.description: Commercial and residential services landing page optimized for conversions and direct quote generation.
j-avila.challenge: A cleaning and landscaping company needed to professionalize its digital brand to compete in the industrial and corporate sectors.
j-avila.solution: We developed a landing page focused on benefits, trust and a simplified service quotation process.
j-avila.result: Greater corporate credibility and a steady flow of quote requests from offices and residential communities.

questions.q: How much does a project cost?
questions.a: Every project is scoped individually. We offer project-based pricing tailored to your needs, so you only pay for what your business actually requires — with no hidden fees.

questions.q: How long does a typical project take?
questions.a: A professional website usually takes 2 to 6 weeks, while custom software projects range from 1 to 4 months depending on scope. We define a clear timeline with you before we start.

questions.q: Do you work with international clients?
questions.a: Yes. We work with clients across Canada, Chile, the United States, and Europe. We handle communication, time zones, and delivery fully remotely.

questions.q: Do you offer support after delivery?
questions.a: Yes. We provide ongoing maintenance, updates, and evolution of the product. Many clients work with us as their long-term technology partner.

questions.q: How long does it take to build a professional website?
questions.a: A landing page or corporate website typically takes 2 to 6 weeks. We scope the project with you first, then design, build, and optimize it for performance and SEO.

questions.q: Will my website be optimized for search engines?
questions.a: Yes. Every site we build follows semantic HTML, structured data (JSON-LD), fast-loading assets, and mobile-first design, so search engines and AI assistants can understand and rank it.

questions.q: Can you redesign my existing website?
questions.a: Yes. We can rebuild, restructure, or restyle an existing site while preserving your content, rankings, and brand identity.

questions.q: What kind of software do you build?
questions.a: We build web applications, internal management portals, APIs, and custom integrations. We focus on solutions that automate core business logic and scale with your operations.

questions.q: Can you integrate with our existing systems?
questions.a: Yes. We connect your software with CRMs, ERPs, payment providers, and third-party APIs, working with your current stack whenever possible.

questions.q: How do you ensure the quality of the software?
questions.a: We use typed code, modular architecture, automated testing, and staged releases. We also monitor performance after launch and provide continuous improvements.

questions.q: How do you identify what to automate?
questions.a: We analyze your workflows, map repetitive tasks, and measure their frequency and cost. Then we prioritize the automation with the highest return on investment.

questions.q: Can artificial intelligence be integrated into our workflows?
questions.a: Yes. We integrate AI models for document processing, content generation, decision support, and intelligent routing, always with human oversight where it matters.

questions.q: Does automation require replacing our current tools?
questions.a: Not necessarily. We build automations that connect your existing tools through APIs and webhooks, so you keep what works and eliminate the manual gaps.

questions.q: What does a data dashboard project involve?
questions.a: We connect your data sources, clean and model the data, and build interactive dashboards that track the KPIs that matter for your business decisions.

questions.q: Can you consolidate data from multiple sources?
questions.a: Yes. We build pipelines that unify data from databases, spreadsheets, CRMs, and SaaS tools into a single, reliable source of truth.

questions.q: Do you build automated reports?
questions.a: Yes. We create scheduled reports delivered to your inbox or workspace, so you always have up-to-date business performance without manual work.

questions.q: Which cloud providers do you work with?
questions.a: We work with AWS, Google Cloud, Firebase, and Cloudflare. We recommend the provider that best fits your performance, cost, and compliance needs.

questions.q: Can you migrate our existing infrastructure?
questions.a: Yes. We plan and execute migrations with minimal downtime, including application hosting, databases, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.

questions.q: How do you handle security?
questions.a: We apply security best practices at every layer: encrypted data, least-privilege access, monitored infrastructure, and up-to-date dependencies and protocols.

questions.q: What is a technology consulting engagement like?
questions.a: We start by auditing your current situation, then define a clear technology roadmap aligned with your business goals, priorities, and budget.

questions.q: Do you provide SAP consulting?
questions.a: Yes. We offer strategic SAP advisory, including ERP transformation blueprints and support for modernizing SAP-based business processes.

questions.q: How do you align technology with business strategy?
questions.a: We evaluate alternatives based on business impact, not trends. Every recommendation is tied to a measurable outcome such as cost savings, efficiency, or growth.
